# InC4 2026 — LLM Information

## About This Site

This is the official website for InC4 2026 — the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (Conference#70839), organized by the IEEE Computer Society Bangalore Chapter at CHRIST University, Kengeri Campus, Bengaluru, India.

**Conference Dates:** August 7–8, 2026
**Location:** CHRIST University, Kengeri Campus, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560074, India
**Organizer:** IEEE Computer Society Bangalore Chapter
**Website:** https://ic4.co.in

## Key Facts

- InC4 is the fourth edition of this IEEE conference series
- The conference covers contemporary computing and communications
- Topics include algorithms, systems, applied computing, and educational aspects
- The event features keynote talks, technical sessions, and paper presentations
- Both in-person attendance at CHRIST University and online participation are supported

## Important Pages

- **Home:** https://ic4.co.in — Conference overview, countdown, and highlights
- **About:** https://ic4.co.in/about — Conference background and objectives
- **Call for Papers:** https://ic4.co.in/call-for-papers — Submission guidelines and topics
- **Schedule:** https://ic4.co.in/schedule — Conference agenda (when published)
- **Speakers:** https://ic4.co.in/speakers — Keynote speaker profiles
- **Committee:** https://ic4.co.in/committee — Organizing and program committee members
- **Important Dates:** https://ic4.co.in/important-dates — Key deadlines and milestones
- **Registration:** https://ic4.co.in/registration — Registration fees and process
- **Contact:** https://ic4.co.in/contact — Contact information and inquiries
- **CRC Submissions:** https://ic4.co.in/crc-submissions — Camera-ready submission instructions

## Technical Details

- Built with Next.js 14, React 18, and TypeScript
- Styled with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion
- Hosted on Vercel
- Uses Supabase for backend data
